observations: A red and blue industrial machine with a conical metal hopper on top.
The red engine section is wrapped in clear plastic, suggesting it is new or unused.
The engine has a yellow warning label and a silver cap, possibly for oil or fuel.
The blue base contains internal gears or rollers, visible in photo 1.
A black electric motor is attached to the side in photo 0 and photo 2, contradicting the seller's claim of a diesel engine.
The machine is placed on a concrete surface with some paint stains.
Watermark 'WILSOTECH AGRO-ALLIED' is visible on all photos.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the engine label or model plate showing the fuel type and specifications.
A video clip of the machine in operation, producing pellets.

response.reason: The seller claims the machine is diesel-powered, but photos show an electric motor attached, contradicting the claim.
